en.headline: 12 own commits plus 22 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **12 own commits** were made across three repositories, plus 22 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 8 own commits added a VS Code recommended-extension list, formatted `providers.json`, adjusted `.gitignore` rules for `.history` and daily-report paths, and improved concurrent diagnostics probing by deduplicating keys with headers and reducing repeated requests. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 3 own commits expanded knowledge documentation on VS Code extensions, keybindings, Copilot/BYOK boundaries, embedding semantics, and two verified VS Code claims. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 1 own commit documented the documentation-site workflow and branch self-checks. The user opened or closed 2 issues: issue `openchamber/openchamber#5584`, titled “[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”, was opened and later commented on, with a reply from `openchamber-bot[bot]` identifying the cause as mostly wiring around `loadHistoryUntilMessage`. Separately, `btriapitsyn` closed `openchamber/openchamber#5556`, “[Bug] Files view: dragging across line numbers to comment is unreliable (web, desktop, VS Code extension)”.

zh.headline: 12 次本人提交，另有 22 次自动提交，涉及三个仓库
zh.summary: **12 次本人提交**分布在三个仓库，另有 22 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 8 次本人提交中，加入了 VS Code 推荐扩展清单，格式化 `providers.json`，调整 `.gitignore` 中 `.history` 与日报路径的忽略规则，并通过为去重键加入 headers、减少重复请求来改进并发探测逻辑。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 3 次本人提交中，扩充了 VS Code 扩展、快捷键、Copilot/BYOK 边界、嵌入语义及两项已核实 VS Code 说法的知识文档。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 1 次本人提交中，补充了文档站工作流与分支自检说明。用户新开或关闭了 2 个 issue：新开 `openchamber/openchamber#5584`“[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”并随后评论，`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复称原因主要在 `loadHistoryUntilMessage` 的接线。此外，`btriapitsyn` 关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber#5556`“[Bug] Files view: dragging across line numbers to comment is unreliable (web, desktop, VS Code extension)”。
